About Coupang
We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did we ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies in the world, establishing an unparalleled reputation as a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.
We offer the best of both worlds: a startup culture backed by the resources of a large, global public company. This fuels our continuous growth and enables us to launch new services at remarkable speed. We are entrepreneurial builders surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people who love to roll up our sleeves and make a direct impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve complex problems and break traditional trade-offs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
About the Team
The Coupang Catalog Team is responsible for hosting billions of products in Coupang's catalog and dynamically processing hundreds of millions of daily updates to provide the single source of truth that powers the online buying experience for millions of customers. We strive to deliver a world-class platform where customers find complete, accurate, and trustworthy product information without friction and at the lowest prices. To achieve this at scale, we continuously invest in cutting-edge AI architectures—leveraging modern Large Language Models (LLMs) and advanced machine learning—to ensure maximum precision, dynamic scalability, and bulletproof platform reliability.
About the Role
The
Director of Catalog Product
will leverage deep expertise in the latest LLM technologies, Generative AI, and advanced machine learning (NLP/NLU, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Algorithmic Modeling) to pioneer next-generation e-commerce solutions. You will design, build, and scale a diverse portfolio of AI-driven products, automation tools, and catalog features that transform how product data is structured, enriched, and presented across Coupang’s vast e-commerce ecosystem.
Operating in a high-growth, rapidly evolving, and often ambiguous environment, you must thrive amidst constant change while maintaining an uncompromising bar for product quality and execution. You will navigate high degrees of operational complexity and drive strategy across international cohorts of senior stakeholders in South Korea, China, and the US (including Retail, Pricing, 3P Marketplace, Search & Discovery, and Finance).
Role Overview
Set the vision and strategic roadmap for Coupang's Catalog platform, pioneering the application of cutting-edge LLMs and Gen AI to solve complex e-commerce challenges (e.g., catalog auto-enrichment, dynamic attribute extraction, automated taxonomy classification, seller content optimization, and fraud/quality detection).
Lead the entire product lifecycle from conceptual AI frameworks through to production implementation in a high-velocity, continuous-deployment ecosystem.
Navigate ambiguity with clarity and conviction, establishing structured roadmaps, making clear trade-off decisions, and maintaining a high standard of quality despite fast-moving constraints.
Drive executive alignment across multi-regional leadership in Engineering, Data Science, Product, Operations, and Infrastructure.
Establish metrics and build automated mechanisms to track performance, system precision, and operational efficiency across billions of catalog entities.
Basic Qualifications
10+ years of product management experience successfully developing and launching innovative tech products at a tier-1 technology company.
Proven track record of applying state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and ML frameworks to complex, high-scale e-commerce or consumer marketplace applications.
Demonstrated ability to thrive in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments, maintaining momentum and producing top-quality outputs under tight timelines and high expectations.
End-to-end experience leading product strategy, establishing roadmaps from conception to launch, defining GTM strategies, and leading complex technical design discussions.
Deep understanding of the modern AI/ML software stack, model evaluation frameworks, and deployment of LLMs at scale.
Experience managing technical and design direction for complex, large-scale distributed systems.
Hands-on mastery of agile methodologies in high-velocity environments (rapid prototyping, A/B testing, data-driven evaluation, and fast iteration).
Expert capability in using quantitative research, data analysis, and rigorous metrics to drive product decision-making across the product lifecycle.
Solid grasp of multi-sided e-commerce marketplace models, catalog architectures, and pricing dynamics.
Experience collaborating with and leading cross-functional teams across multiple international geographies.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.
We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
WHY DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS?
The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and acumen of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product groups, we use this vast tool belt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products and measure the impact on our community of players and developers.
WHY Consumer Apps?
Roblox is used by tens of millions of people every day across a wide range of devices, including mobile, desktop, console, TV, and VR. The Consumer Apps team owns the app foundation that makes Roblox feel fast, fluid, and reliable for players and is dedicated to delivering superior performance, reliability, and user experience across all platforms Roblox supports. This team ensures a seamless and engaging user interface that facilitates intuitive interactions while enabling efficient, high-quality experiences across devices. Innovation is at the core of our work, as we continuously enhance features and integrate cutting-edge technologies to solve complex problems.
As a Data Scientist on the team, you will help accelerate Roblox’s growth by shaping how we launch and optimize Roblox across the diverse device ecosystems where people connect, play, and co-experience. You will partner with Mobile, Desktop, Console, and emerging-platform teams to identify opportunities and develop platform-specific strategies that make Roblox feel best-in-class on every device. You will use data to guide investments across platform expansion, platform-specific product experiences, and ecosystem partnerships. You will develop measurement and experimentation frameworks to understand both the direct and broader ecosystem impact of these investments, helping teams identify growth opportunities, make informed tradeoffs, and continuously improve the Roblox experience while expanding universal access.
You Will:
Identify high-potential platform levers and apply causal methods to understand their impact on user behavior, engagement, monetization, and other topline outcomes, translating these insights into platform-specific strategies.
Develop deep expertise in the unique dynamics of each platform — including how the product is experienced, how user cohorts differ, and what drives their behavior — and proactively bring this perspective to broader research and cross-functional decision-making to identify opportunities and explain differences in product and business outcomes.
Build visibility into platform-level business performance and establish growth targets informed by internal data, market research, and competitive insights.
Design and analyze experiments to evaluate product launches, inform iteration, and drive rigorous, data-informed product decisions.
Advance how we measure product impact by developing innovative measurement and causal inference approaches where traditional A/B testing is not feasible, expanding the range of platform investments we can evaluate with rigor and confidence.
Elevate data and experimentation rigor across the broader team by building scalable frameworks and practices around experiment design, success metrics, launch criteria, and launch readiness — helping teams launch confidently and consistently.
Build scalable monitoring and diagnostic capabilities that enable teams to quickly identify trends, investigate changes, and understand root causes.
Partner across Data Science, Product, and Engineering — including Growth, Discovery, Social, and other product areas — to connect insights across surfaces, understand how platform and product changes affect the broader ecosystem, and translate complex data into actionable recommendations that shape strategy and drive impactful platform improvements.
You Have:
An advanced degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
8+ years of industry experience in Data Science or a related quantitative discipline, preferably working on consumer-facing products or applications.
Strong analytical and technical skills, with proficiency in Python or R, SQL, and large-scale data processing and workflow tools such as Spark and Airflow.
Deep expertise in statistical analysis, causal inference, experimentation, and measurement methodologies, with a track record of applying these techniques to shape product strategy and drive business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces, applying first-principles thinking to develop novel frameworks, approaches, and solutions.
Proven ability to influence across Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, and leadership, shaping strategy, prioritizing investments, and driving alignment across organizational boundaries.
Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to distill complex, high-dimensional problems into clear insights and actionable recommendations for both technical and executive audiences.

Clare, Ireland Lead Operations. Develop People. Drive Performance. At RTX, 185,000 talented people are united by a shared purpose: solving some of the world’s most complex challenges and helping to shape the future of aerospace and defence. Collins Aerospace, an RTX business, is a leader in technologically advanced and intelligent solutions for the global aerospace and defence industry. Across our worldwide operations, we combine deep technical expertise, innovation and operational excellence to help keep the world moving safely and reliably. We are now looking for an experienced Operations Leader to optimise performance at our Collins Aerospace Aftermarket site in Shannon . This is a key site leadership position reporting to the General Manager / Accountable Manager, with responsibility for the safe, compliant and efficient operation of the repair station, alongside oversight of site facilities and auditing of the monthly shop floor bonus scheme. Working closely with a team of Production Supervisors, you will create an environment in which our people can perform at their best while delivering against our commitments in Product Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and Employee Engagement . If you are an experienced operations leader who enjoys developing people, improving processes and turning operational challenges into measurable results, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact in a leading company within a growing industry. What You Will Do Lead and Develop Team Members You will provide visible, hands-on leadership across the repair operation, creating a culture built around accountability, collaboration, respect and continuous improvement. You will: Take responsibility for repair personnel and collaborate with other functions to support the site’s performance and business targets. Deputise for the Workshop Manager when required. Build a high-performing and highly engaged culture where people feel empowered to contribute, challenge and improve. Set clear expectations and drive accountability for operational performance within your area of responsibility. Identify talent and development needs, creating opportunities for professional growth across the team. Maintain the competence of maintenance personnel by continually identifying training gaps and ensuring appropriate skill sets are maintained. Ensure accurate and timely submission of team time records across your area of responsibility. Own Operational Performance You will be responsible for achieving output, quality, efficiency and safety targets within your area of responsibility. You will: Develop and execute production plans within your area of responsibility. Drive performance against key measures, including on-time delivery, quality, productivity and cost . Monitor and analyse operational KPIs, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for improvement. Forecast resource, capacity and capability requirements to support production demand and future growth. Drive disciplined execution of daily Lean management, including tiered accountability meetings, visual management and leader standard work. Take prompt corrective action where performance falls short of plan. Audit the monthly shop floor bonus scheme, verifying supporting performance data and calculations against the agreed scheme criteria, resolving discrepancies with relevant stakeholders and maintaining clear records to support accurate and timely payment. Oversee Site Facilities You will oversee day-to-day facilities management at the Shannon site, ensuring the workplace and supporting infrastructure enable safe, reliable and efficient operations. You will: Coordinate planned maintenance, repairs and upkeep of the building, utilities and supporting site infrastructure. Liaise with external contractors and service providers, coordinating work to minimise disruption to repair operations. Work closely with EHS, Quality and other relevant functions to ensure facilities activities meet applicable safety requirements and company procedures. Monitor facilities issues, prioritise corrective actions and escalate risks, expenditure requirements and infrastructure needs to the General Manager. Champion Continuous Improvement Continuous improvement will be central to your leadership approach. You will take ownership of CORE continuous improvement initiatives , creating and sustaining an improvement strategy aligned with the wider objectives of Collins Aerospace and RTX. You will: Identify, prioritise and deliver continuous improvement projects across the operation. Use Lean and CI methodologies, including Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen and Root Cause Analysis . Work cross-functionally to remove bottlenecks, eliminate waste and streamline repair and production processes. Engage employees at all levels in identifying and implementing better ways of working. Track the impact of improvement initiatives against agreed KPIs. Deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cost and operational performance. Lead improvement events using the company’s continuous improvement programme, CORE. You will be a change leader , bringing people with you as you implement improvement projects and initiatives. Put Safety, Quality and Compliance First Operating within a regulated aerospace environment means safety, quality and compliance are fundamental to everything we do. Within your area of responsibility, you will ensure maintenance standards are achieved in accordance with Part 145.A.65 and approved maintenance data. Your responsibilities will include: Ensuring compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements and company policies. Maintaining a strong, proactive safety culture across the operation. Ensuring the correct handling, identification and tagging of parts and units throughout the repair process. Ensuring tools are appropriately controlled, segregated, preserved and maintained in serviceable condition. Maintaining documentation integrity and ensuring maintenance entries, forms and work orders are correctly completed. Ensuring continuity of repair activity when personnel, shifts or assignments change. Ensuring satisfactory completion of customer work in accordance with approved data, procedures and quality standards. Completing agreed corrective actions arising from Quality Audits within required timescales. Deliver for Our Customers Our customers depend on us for quality, reliability and delivery. You will work closely with Quality, Engineering and other cross-functional partners to ensure we consistently meet those commitments. You will help build a culture where teams understand the connection between their everyday decisions and the experience we provide to our customers, ensuring work is completed safely, compliantly, efficiently and to the highest quality standards. Help Shape the Future of the Shannon Operation Beyond today’s operational requirements, you will work with senior leadership to help shape the site’s future. You will contribute to strategic planning, capacity and resource forecasting, and operational improvement, ensuring the Shannon operation is positioned to respond to changing customer requirements and future growth opportunities. What You Will Bring We are looking for an established operations leader who combines strong people leadership with a passion for operational excellence. Ideally, you will bring: A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration or a related discipline. An advanced degree would be advantageous. 8+ years’ experience in production or operations management within aerospace, manufacturing, MedTech or another highly regulated environment. Proven experience leading, coaching and developing high-performing operational teams. Strong experience delivering continuous improvement within a manufacturing, production or repair environment . Practical knowledge of Lean and CI methodologies, with evidence of delivering measurable improvements in cost, productivity, quality or delivery. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification would be advantageous. Strong project management capability and experience delivering improvement programmes from concept through to implementation. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills. The ability to communicate, influence and build effective relationships across different functions and levels of an organisation. Strong SAP and Microsoft Office skills. What we Offer Excellent Pension Scheme Health Insurance 25.5 days annual leave Bonus scheme Employee assistance program Why Join Collins Aerospace? This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible operational leadership role within one of the world's leading aerospace and defence organisations. You will have the scope to lead people, influence site performance, strengthen operational capability and drive meaningful change , while working within a global organisation that continues to invest in technology, people and continuous improvement. At Collins Aerospace, the challenge is not simply to keep operations moving. It is to keep making them better. Join us in Shannon and help shape the future of aerospace. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
